Does not substitute C-inventory's questions for confirmed hours or claim within-task output is task-delivered readiness.
Keeps Q-language ownership/blocking obligation and distinguishes cross-task preparation promises from actual ordering edges.
Does not spawn/queue tasks, invent dependencies from unrelated phase labels or duplicate shared prerequisite identity.
